questions: What is lift?
If the lift fails, does it stay where it is?
What is a stall?
When the stall begins, does it stop moving?
What is a burn?
After a burn, does it leave a mark?
What is the skin?
If the skin is damaged, does it heal on its own?
What is a stage?
When the stage is over, is the whole thing over?
What is attitude?
If the attitude changes suddenly, does that mean something is wrong?
What is a fairing?
When the fairing comes off, has something gone wrong?
What is surge?
When the surge starts, will it settle down on its own?
What is choke?
If it is choked, can more still get through?
What is bleed?
If there is a bleed, does something have to be leaking?
What is pitch?
If the pitch goes up, does it sound higher?
What is an abort?
If the abort is called, does everything stop immediately?
What is a coast?
When the coast begins, does it mean you've arrived?
What is a payload?
If the payload is dropped, can anything still be delivered?
What is deployment?
After deployment, is it ready for everyone to use?
